_readme: Company intelligence used by intel/companies.py. Matching normalizes the employer string (lowercase, strip punctuation and Inc/LLC/Ltd), then tries exact alias matches and finally whole-word alias search, longest alias first. Prefix an alias with '=' to allow only an exact whole-name match (use it for short or ambiguous names such as 'sig' or 'td'). Board entries in config.json may pin a company with "company_key". Add firms here, not in code. 'type' must be one of the keys in 'types'. Tech employer types (big_tech through public_sector) are coarse groupings for ranking and Settings; a firm has exactly one. A type's 'track' (finance, tech or both) decides which profiles poll a source of that employer: finance tracks for Finance, tech tracks for Software, AI & Data, Hardware, Product and Design; types without one are polled for everyone.
